observations.command:
set -eu
echo BEGIN
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo TTYUSB_PARENT
for p in /sys/class/tty/ttyUSB0/device /sys/class/tty/ttyUSB0/device/driver; do echo "$p"; readlink -f "$p"; done
echo MATCHING_USB_DEVICE
for p in /sys/bus/usb/devices/*; do
 if test -r "$p/idVendor" && test -r "$p/idProduct"; then
  v=$(cat "$p/idVendor")
  q=$(cat "$p/idProduct")
  if test "$v:$q" = 04e8:20e4; then
   echo "$p"
   readlink -f "$p"
   for f in idVendor idProduct manufacturer product bDeviceClass bDeviceSubClass bDeviceProtocol bcdDevice busnum devnum; do if test -r "$p/$f"; then echo "$f=$(cat "$p/$f")"; fi; done
   for c in "$p":*; do if test -d "$c"; then echo "$c"; for f in bInterfaceClass bInterfaceSubClass bInterfaceProtocol interface; do if test -r "$c/$f"; then echo "$f=$(cat "$c/$f")"; fi; done; if test -e "$c/driver"; then readlink -f "$c/driver"; fi; fi; done
  fi
 fi
done
echo END
